Description: Susceptible individuals become infected and move to the first exposed compartment.
Individuals progress from the first to the second exposed sub-compartment.
Exposed individuals become infectious and enter the first infectious sub-compartment.
Individuals progress from the first to the second infectious sub-compartment.

Name: δt
Description: The length of discrete time intervals in the SEIR model.

Name: γ
Description: The daily rate of transition from infectious to removed compartments.

Name: λ(t)
Description: The time-varying rate at which a person becomes infected.

Name: β
Description: The constant transmission rate, representing the rate at which new infections occur given a contact.

Name: ψ
Description: The Exponential Growth Rate (EGR) at the start of the epidemic.

Name: π
Description: The proportion of the population who is initially susceptible.

Name: λ0
Description: The initial infection rate at time t=0.

Name: R0
Description: The basic reproduction number, the average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a fully susceptible population.

Name: Rn
Description: The effective reproduction number, the average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a partially susceptible population.

Name: p_ICU
Description: The proportion of infected people who are admitted to ICU/HDU.

Name: σ^2_ICU|E
Description: The variance of the Gamma-distributed waiting period from infection to ICU admission.

Name: η
Description: The dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial distribution of weekly ICU/HDU admissions.
